shortDescription: Explore our collection of stunning glass projects and discover ideas to transform your home or business. From modern shower doors to custom glass installations, find the perfect design that matches your style and vision.
details: Uplift your space with the simple, elegant and clean design of Canto door. Beautifully crafted from veneer (available in beech, teak, ash and mahogany) with a range of elegant finishes, Canto allows you to easily mix and match any veneer and finish type that best suits your design aesthetics. An alluring diagonal pattern gives timeless look while the highly-durable structure with semi-solid core and resilient jamb frame assembly provides lasting durability, making it perfect for both interiors and exteriors. Multiple configurations such as single, double acting, sliding or folding offers you ample alteration options to configure the door to best match you layout. Also available with the option of fire-rated technology, Canto can provide an extra layer of safety by reducing the spread of smoke and flames during the outbreak of fire.
features: Interior doors should not be regularly exposed to extreme weather conditions such as direct sunlight, intense heat, freezing temperatures, rainfall, excessive humidity etc. When purchasing doors, always specify whether the requirement is for indoor or outdoor.
We offer a separate range of exterior and main doors that are specially treated to resist harsh environmental factors.
